n: نحن اعلم بما يقولون وما انت عليهم بجبار فذكر بالقرءان من يخاف وعيد
t: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat

n: والذريت ذروا
t: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing

n: فالحملت وقرا
t: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

n: فالجريت يسرا
t: And those [ships] sailing with ease

n: فالمقسمت امرا
t: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter

n: انما توعدون لصادق
t: Indeed, what you are promised is true

n: وان الدين لوقع
t: And indeed, the recompense is to occur

n: والسماء ذات الحبك
t: By the heaven containing pathways

n: انكم لفي قول مختلف
t: Indeed, you are in differing speech

n: يوفك عنه من افك
t: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded

n: قتل الخرصون
t: Destroyed are the falsifiers

n: الذين هم في غمره ساهون
t: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless

n: يسلون ايان يوم الدين
t: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense

n: يوم هم علي النار يفتنون
t: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

n: ذوقوا فتنتكم هذا الذي كنتم به تستعجلون
t: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient

n: ان المتقين في جنت وعيون
t: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs

n: ءاخذين ما ءاتيهم ربهم انهم كانوا قبل ذلك محسنين
t: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good

n: كانوا قليلا من اليل ما يهجعون
t: They used to sleep but little of the night

n: وبالاسحار هم يستغفرون
t: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness

n: وفي امولهم حق للسايل والمحروم
t: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived

n: وفي الارض ءايت للموقنين
t: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

n: وفي انفسكم افلا تبصرون
t: And in yourselves. Then will you not see

n: وفي السماء رزقكم وما توعدون
t: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised

n: فورب السماء والارض انه لحق مثل ما انكم تنطقون
t: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking

n: هل اتيك حديث ضيف ابرهيم المكرمين
t: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham

n: اذ دخلوا عليه فقالوا سلما قال سلم قوم منكرون
t: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown

n: فراغ الي اهله فجاء بعجل سمين
t: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf

n: فقربه اليهم قال الا تاكلون
t: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat

n: فاوجس منهم خيفه قالوا لا تخف وبشروه بغلم عليم
t: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy

n: فاقبلت امراته في صره فصكت وجهها وقالت عجوز عقيم
t: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman

n: قالوا كذلك قال ربك انه هو الحكيم العليم
t: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing

n: قال فما خطبكم ايها المرسلون
t: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers

n: قالوا انا ارسلنا الي قوم مجرمين
t: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

n: لنرسل عليهم حجاره من طين
t: To send down upon them stones of clay

n: مسومه عند ربك للمسرفين
t: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors

n: فاخرجنا من كان فيها من المومنين
t: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers

n: فما وجدنا فيها غير بيت من المسلمين
t: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims

n: وتركنا فيها ءايه للذين يخافون العذاب الاليم
t: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment

n: وفي موسي اذ ارسلنه الي فرعون بسلطن مبين
t: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority

n: فتولي بركنه وقال سحر او مجنون
t: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman

n: فاخذنه وجنوده فنبذنهم في اليم وهو مليم
t: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy

n: وفي عاد اذ ارسلنا عليهم الريح العقيم
t: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind

n: ما تذر من شيء اتت عليه الا جعلته كالرميم
t: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins

n: وفي ثمود اذ قيل لهم تمتعوا حتي حين
t: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time

n: فعتوا عن امر ربهم فاخذتهم الصعقه وهم ينظرون
t: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on

n: فما استطعوا من قيام وما كانوا منتصرين
t: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves

n: وقوم نوح من قبل انهم كانوا قوما فسقين
t: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient

n: والسماء بنينها باييد وانا لموسعون
t: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander

n: والارض فرشنها فنعم المهدون
t: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer

n: ومن كل شيء خلقنا زوجين لعلكم تذكرون
t: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember

n: ففروا الي الله اني لكم منه نذير مبين
t: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner

n: ولا تجعلوا مع الله الها ءاخر اني لكم منه نذير مبين
t: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner

n: كذلك ما اتي الذين من قبلهم من رسول الا قالوا ساحر او مجنون
t: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman

n: اتواصوا به بل هم قوم طاغون
t: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people

n: فتول عنهم فما انت بملوم
t: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed

n: وذكر فان الذكري تنفع المومنين
t: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers

n: وما خلقت الجن والانس الا ليعبدون
t: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me

n: ما اريد منهم من رزق وما اريد ان يطعمون
t: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me

n: ان الله هو الرزاق ذو القوه المتين
t: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength

n: فان للذين ظلموا ذنوبا مثل ذنوب اصحبهم فلا يستعجلون
t: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me

n: فويل للذين كفروا من يومهم الذي يوعدون
t: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised

n: والطور
t: By the mount

n: وكتب مسطور
t: And [by] a Book inscribed

n: في رق منشور
t: In parchment spread open

n: والبيت المعمور
t: And [by] the frequented House

n: والسقف المرفوع
t: And [by] the heaven raised high

n: والبحر المسجور
t: And [by] the sea filled [with fire]

n: ان عذاب ربك لوقع
t: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur

n: ما له من دافع
t: Of it there is no preventer

n: يوم تمور السماء مورا
t: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

n: وتسير الجبال سيرا
t: And the mountains will pass on, departing

n: فويل يوميذ للمكذبين
t: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers

n: الذين هم في خوض يلعبون
t: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves

n: يوم يدعون الي نار جهنم دعا
t: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say]

n: هذه النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون
t: This is the Fire which you used to deny

n: افسحر هذا ام انتم لا تبصرون
t: Then is this magic, or do you not see

n: اصلوها فاصبروا او لا تصبروا سواء عليكم انما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
t: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do

n: ان المتقين في جنت ونعيم
t: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure

n: فكهين بما ءاتيهم ربهم ووقيهم ربهم عذاب الجحيم
t: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

n: كلوا واشربوا هنيا بما كنتم تعملون
t: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do

n: متكين علي سرر مصفوفه وزوجنهم بحور عين
t: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes

n: والذين ءامنوا واتبعتهم ذريتهم بايمن الحقنا بهم ذريتهم وما التنهم من عملهم من شيء كل امري بما كسب رهين
t: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained

n: وامددنهم بفكهه ولحم مما يشتهون
t: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire

n: يتنزعون فيها كاسا لا لغو فيها ولا تاثيم
t: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin

n: ويطوف عليهم غلمان لهم كانهم لولو مكنون
t: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected

n: واقبل بعضهم علي بعض يتساءلون
t: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other

n: قالوا انا كنا قبل في اهلنا مشفقين
t: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah]

n: فمن الله علينا ووقينا عذاب السموم
t: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire

n: انا كنا من قبل ندعوه انه هو البر الرحيم
t: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful

n: فذكر فما انت بنعمت ربك بكاهن ولا مجنون
t: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman

n: ام يقولون شاعر نتربص به ريب المنون
t: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time

n: قل تربصوا فاني معكم من المتربصين
t: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters

n: ام تامرهم احلمهم بهذا ام هم قوم طاغون
t: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people

n: ام يقولون تقوله بل لا يومنون
t: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe

n: فلياتوا بحديث مثله ان كانوا صدقين
t: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful

n: ام خلقوا من غير شيء ام هم الخلقون
t: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]

n: ام خلقوا السموت والارض بل لا يوقنون
t: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain

n: ام عندهم خزاين ربك ام هم المصيطرون
t: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]

n: ام لهم سلم يستمعون فيه فليات مستمعهم بسلطن مبين
t: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority

n: ام له البنت ولكم البنون
t: Or has He daughters while you have sons

n: ام تسلهم اجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون
t: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down

n: ام عندهم الغيب فهم يكتبون
t: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down

n: ام يريدون كيدا فالذين كفروا هم المكيدون
t: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan

n: ام لهم اله غير الله سبحن الله عما يشركون
t: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him

n: وان يروا كسفا من السماء ساقطا يقولوا سحاب مركوم
t: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up

n: فذرهم حتي يلقوا يومهم الذي فيه يصعقون
t: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible

n: يوم لا يغني عنهم كيدهم شيا ولا هم ينصرون
t: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped

n: وان للذين ظلموا عذابا دون ذلك ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
t: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know

n: واصبر لحكم ربك فانك باعيننا وسبح بحمد ربك حين تقوم
t: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise

n: ومن اليل فسبحه وادبر النجوم
t: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars

n: والنجم اذا هوي
t: By the star when it descends

n: ما ضل صاحبكم وما غوي
t: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred

n: وما ينطق عن الهوي
t: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination

n: ان هو الا وحي يوحي
t: It is not but a revelation revealed

n: علمه شديد القوي
t: Taught to him by one intense in strength

n: ذو مره فاستوي
t: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form

n: وهو بالافق الاعلي
t: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon

n: ثم دنا فتدلي
t: Then he approached and descended

n: فكان قاب قوسين او ادني
t: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer

n: فاوحي الي عبده ما اوحي
t: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed

n: ما كذب الفواد ما راي
t: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw

n: افتمرونه علي ما يري
t: So will you dispute with him over what he saw

n: ولقد رءاه نزله اخري
t: And he certainly saw him in another descent

n: عند سدره المنتهي
t: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary

n: عندها جنه الماوي
t: Near it is the Garden of Refuge

n: اذ يغشي السدره ما يغشي
t: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it]

n: ما زاغ البصر وما طغي
t: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit]

n: لقد راي من ءايت ربه الكبري
t: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord

n: افرءيتم اللت والعزي
t: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza

n: ومنوه الثالثه الاخري
t: And Manat, the third - the other one

n: الكم الذكر وله الانثي
t: Is the male for you and for Him the female

n: تلك اذا قسمه ضيزي
t: That, then, is an unjust division

n: ان هي الا اسماء سميتموها انتم وءاباوكم ما انزل الله بها من سلطن ان يتبعون الا الظن وما تهوي الانفس ولقد جاءهم من ربهم الهدي
t: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance

n: ام للانسن ما تمني
t: Or is there for man whatever he wishes

n: فلله الاخره والاولي
t: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]

n: وكم من ملك في السموت لا تغني شفعتهم شيا الا من بعد ان ياذن الله لمن يشاء ويرضي
t: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves

n: ان الذين لا يومنون بالاخره ليسمون المليكه تسميه الانثي
t: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names

n: وما لهم به من علم ان يتبعون الا الظن وان الظن لا يغني من الحق شيا
t: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all

n: فاعرض عن من تولي عن ذكرنا ولم يرد الا الحيوه الدنيا
t: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life

n: ذلك مبلغهم من العلم ان ربك هو اعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو اعلم بمن اهتدي
t: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided

n: ولله ما في السموت وما في الارض ليجزي الذين اسوا بما عملوا ويجزي الذين احسنوا بالحسني
t: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward]

n: الذين يجتنبون كبير الاثم والفوحش الا اللمم ان ربك وسع المغفره هو اعلم بكم اذ انشاكم من الارض واذ انتم اجنه في بطون امهتكم فلا تزكوا انفسكم هو اعلم بمن اتقي
t: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him

n: افرءيت الذي تولي
t: Have you seen the one who turned away

n: واعطي قليلا واكدي
t: And gave a little and [then] refrained

n: اعنده علم الغيب فهو يري
t: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees

n: ام لم ينبا بما في صحف موسي
t: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

n: وابرهيم الذي وفي
t: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations]

n: الا تزر وازره وزر اخري
t: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

n: وان ليس للانسن الا ما سعي
t: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

n: وان سعيه سوف يري
t: And that his effort is going to be seen

n: ثم يجزيه الجزاء الاوفي
t: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense

n: وان الي ربك المنتهي
t: And that to your Lord is the finality

n: وانه هو اضحك وابكي
t: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

n: وانه هو امات واحيا
t: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

n: وانه خلق الزوجين الذكر والانثي
t: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female

n: من نطفه اذا تمني
t: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

n: وان عليه النشاه الاخري
t: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation

n: وانه هو اغني واقني
t: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

n: وانه هو رب الشعري
t: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius

n: وانه اهلك عادا الاولي
t: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad

n: وثمودا فما ابقي
t: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them]

n: وقوم نوح من قبل انهم كانوا هم اظلم واطغي
t: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing

n: والموتفكه اهوي
t: And the overturned towns He hurled down

n: فغشيها ما غشي
t: And covered them by that which He covered

n: فباي ءالاء ربك تتماري
t: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt

n: هذا نذير من النذر الاولي
t: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners

n: ازفت الازفه
t: The Approaching Day has approached

n: ليس لها من دون الله كاشفه
t: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover

n: افمن هذا الحديث تعجبون
t: Then at this statement do you wonder

n: وتضحكون ولا تبكون
t: And you laugh and do not weep

n: وانتم سمدون
t: While you are proudly sporting

n: فاسجدوا لله واعبدوا
t: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him]

n: اقتربت الساعه وانشق القمر
t: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two]

n: وان يروا ءايه يعرضوا ويقولوا سحر مستمر
t: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic

n: وكذبوا واتبعوا اهواءهم وكل امر مستقر
t: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement

n: ولقد جاءهم من الانباء ما فيه مزدجر
t: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence

n: حكمه بلغه فما تغن النذر
t: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them]

n: فتول عنهم يوم يدع الداع الي شيء نكر
t: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding

n: خشعا ابصرهم يخرجون من الاجداث كانهم جراد منتشر
t: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading

n: مهطعين الي الداع يقول الكفرون هذا يوم عسر
t: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day

n: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح فكذبوا عبدنا وقالوا مجنون وازدجر
t: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled

n: فدعا ربه اني مغلوب فانتصر
t: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help

n: ففتحنا ابوب السماء بماء منهمر
t: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

n: وفجرنا الارض عيونا فالتقي الماء علي امر قد قدر
t: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined

n: وحملنه علي ذات الوح ودسر
t: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails

n: تجري باعيننا جزاء لمن كان كفر
t: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied

n: ولقد تركنها ءايه فهل من مدكر
t: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember

n: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
t: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning

n: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
t: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

n: كذبت عاد فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
t: Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning

n: انا ارسلنا عليهم ريحا صرصرا في يوم نحس مستمر
t: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune

n: تنزع الناس كانهم اعجاز نخل منقعر
t: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted

n: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
t: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning

n: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
t: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

n: كذبت ثمود بالنذر
t: Thamud denied the warning

n: فقالوا ابشرا منا وحدا نتبعه انا اذا لفي ضلل وسعر
t: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness

n: اءلقي الذكر عليه من بيننا بل هو كذاب اشر
t: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar

n: سيعلمون غدا من الكذاب الاشر
t: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar

n: انا مرسلوا الناقه فتنه لهم فارتقبهم واصطبر
t: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient

n: ونبيهم ان الماء قسمه بينهم كل شرب محتضر
t: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn]

n: فنادوا صاحبهم فتعاطي فعقر
t: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]

n: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
t: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning

n: انا ارسلنا عليهم صيحه وحده فكانوا كهشيم المحتظر
t: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen

n: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
t: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

n: كذبت قوم لوط بالنذر
t: The people of Lot denied the warning

n: انا ارسلنا عليهم حاصبا الا ءال لوط نجينهم بسحر
t: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn

n: نعمه من عندنا كذلك نجزي من شكر
t: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful

n: ولقد انذرهم بطشتنا فتماروا بالنذر
t: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning

n: ولقد رودوه عن ضيفه فطمسنا اعينهم فذوقوا عذابي ونذر
t: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning

n: ولقد صبحهم بكره عذاب مستقر
t: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment

n: فذوقوا عذابي ونذر
t: So taste My punishment and warning

n: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
t: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

n: ولقد جاء ءال فرعون النذر
t: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning

n: كذبوا بايتنا كلها فاخذنهم اخذ عزيز مقتدر
t: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability

n: اكفاركم خير من اوليكم ام لكم براءه في الزبر
t: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture

n: ام يقولون نحن جميع منتصر
t: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]

n: سيهزم الجمع ويولون الدبر
t: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat]

n: بل الساعه موعدهم والساعه ادهي وامر
t: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter

n: ان المجرمين في ضلل وسعر
t: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness

n: يوم يسحبون في النار علي وجوههم ذوقوا مس سقر
t: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar

n: انا كل شيء خلقنه بقدر
t: Indeed, all things We created with predestination

n: وما امرنا الا وحده كلمح بالبصر
t: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye

n: ولقد اهلكنا اشياعكم فهل من مدكر
t: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember

n: وكل شيء فعلوه في الزبر
t: And everything they did is in written records

n: وكل صغير وكبير مستطر
t: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed

n: ان المتقين في جنت ونهر
t: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers

n: في مقعد صدق عند مليك مقتدر
t: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability

n: الرحمن
t: The Most Merciful

n: علم القرءان
t: Taught the Qur'an

n: خلق الانسن
t: Created man

n: علمه البيان
t: [And] taught him eloquence

n: الشمس والقمر بحسبان
t: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation

n: والنجم والشجر يسجدان
t: And the stars and trees prostrate

n: والسماء رفعها ووضع الميزان
t: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

n: الا تطغوا في الميزان
t: That you not transgress within the balance

n: واقيموا الوزن بالقسط ولا تخسروا الميزان
t: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance

n: والارض وضعها للانام
t: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures

n: فيها فكهه والنخل ذات الاكمام
t: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

n: والحب ذو العصف والريحان
t: And grain having husks and scented plants

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: خلق الانسن من صلصل كالفخار
t: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery

n: وخلق الجان من مارج من نار
t: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: رب المشرقين ورب المغربين
t: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: مرج البحرين يلتقيان
t: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side]

n: بينهما برزخ لا يبغيان
t: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: يخرج منهما اللولو والمرجان
t: From both of them emerge pearl and coral

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: وله الجوار المنشات في البحر كالاعلم
t: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: كل من عليها فان
t: Everyone upon the earth will perish

n: ويبقي وجه ربك ذو الجلل والاكرام
t: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: يسله من في السموت والارض كل يوم هو في شان
t: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: سنفرغ لكم ايه الثقلان
t: We will attend to you, O prominent beings

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: يمعشر الجن والانس ان استطعتم ان تنفذوا من اقطار السموت والارض فانفذوا لا تنفذون الا بسلطن
t: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah]

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: يرسل عليكما شواظ من نار ونحاس فلا تنتصران
t: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: فاذا انشقت السماء فكانت ورده كالدهان
t: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: فيوميذ لا يسل عن ذنبه انس ولا جان
t: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: يعرف المجرمون بسيمهم فيوخذ بالنوصي والاقدام
t: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: هذه جهنم التي يكذب بها المجرمون
t: This is Hell, which the criminals deny

n: يطوفون بينها وبين حميم ءان
t: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree]

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: ولمن خاف مقام ربه جنتان
t: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: ذواتا افنان
t: Having [spreading] branches

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: فيهما عينان تجريان
t: In both of them are two springs, flowing

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: فيهما من كل فكهه زوجان
t: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: متكين علي فرش بطاينها من استبرق وجني الجنتين دان
t: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: فيهن قصرت الطرف لم يطمثهن انس قبلهم ولا جان
t: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: كانهن الياقوت والمرجان
t: As if they were rubies and coral

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: هل جزاء الاحسن الا الاحسن
t: Is the reward for good [anything] but good

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: ومن دونهما جنتان
t: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: مدهامتان
t: Dark green [in color]

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: فيهما عينان نضاختان
t: In both of them are two springs, spouting

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: فيهما فكهه ونخل ورمان
t: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: فيهن خيرت حسان
t: In them are good and beautiful women

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: حور مقصورت في الخيام
t: Fair ones reserved in pavilions

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: لم يطمثهن انس قبلهم ولا جان
t: Untouched before them by man or jinni

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: متكين علي رفرف خضر وعبقري حسان
t: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets

n: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

n: تبرك اسم ربك ذي الجلل والاكرام
t: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor

n: اذا وقعت الواقعه
t: When the Occurrence occurs

n: ليس لوقعتها كاذبه
t: There is, at its occurrence, no denial

n: خافضه رافعه
t: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others]

n: اذا رجت الارض رجا
t: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

n: وبست الجبال بسا
t: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

n: فكانت هباء منبثا
t: And become dust dispersing

n: وكنتم ازوجا ثلثه
t: And you become [of] three kinds

n: فاصحب الميمنه ما اصحب الميمنه
t: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right

n: واصحب المشمه ما اصحب المشمه
t: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left

n: والسبقون السبقون
t: And the forerunners, the forerunners

n: اوليك المقربون
t: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]

n: في جنت النعيم
t: In the Gardens of Pleasure

n: ثله من الاولين
t: A [large] company of the former peoples

n: وقليل من الاخرين
t: And a few of the later peoples

n: علي سرر موضونه
t: On thrones woven [with ornament]

n: متكين عليها متقبلين
t: Reclining on them, facing each other

n: يطوف عليهم ولدن مخلدون
t: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal

n: باكواب واباريق وكاس من معين
t: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring

n: لا يصدعون عنها ولا ينزفون
t: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated

n: وفكهه مما يتخيرون
t: And fruit of what they select

n: ولحم طير مما يشتهون
t: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire

n: وحور عين
t: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes

n: كامثل اللولو المكنون
t: The likenesses of pearls well-protected

n: جزاء بما كانوا يعملون
t: As reward for what they used to do

n: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا تاثيما
t: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin

n: الا قيلا سلما سلما
t: Only a saying: "Peace, peace

n: واصحب اليمين ما اصحب اليمين
t: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right

n: في سدر مخضود
t: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed

n: وطلح منضود
t: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]

n: وظل ممدود
t: And shade extended

n: وماء مسكوب
t: And water poured out

n: وفكهه كثيره
t: And fruit, abundant [and varied]

n: لا مقطوعه ولا ممنوعه
t: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden

n: وفرش مرفوعه
t: And [upon] beds raised high

n: انا انشانهن انشاء
t: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation

n: فجعلنهن ابكارا
t: And made them virgins

n: عربا اترابا
t: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age

n: لاصحب اليمين
t: For the companions of the right [who are]

n: ثله من الاولين
t: A company of the former peoples

n: وثله من الاخرين
t: And a company of the later peoples

n: واصحب الشمال ما اصحب الشمال
t: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left

n: في سموم وحميم
t: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

n: وظل من يحموم
t: And a shade of black smoke

n: لا بارد ولا كريم
t: Neither cool nor beneficial

n: انهم كانوا قبل ذلك مترفين
t: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence

n: وكانوا يصرون علي الحنث العظيم
t: And they used to persist in the great violation

n: وكانوا يقولون ايذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما اءنا لمبعوثون
t: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected

n: اوءاباونا الاولون
t: And our forefathers [as well]

n: قل ان الاولين والاخرين
t: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples

n: لمجموعون الي ميقت يوم معلوم
t: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day

n: ثم انكم ايها الضالون المكذبون
t: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers

n: لاكلون من شجر من زقوم
t: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum

n: فمالون منها البطون
t: And filling with it your bellies

n: فشربون عليه من الحميم
t: And drinking on top of it from scalding water

n: فشربون شرب الهيم
t: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels

n: هذا نزلهم يوم الدين
t: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense

n: نحن خلقنكم فلولا تصدقون
t: We have created you, so why do you not believe

n: افرءيتم ما تمنون
t: Have you seen that which you emit

n: ءانتم تخلقونه ام نحن الخلقون
t: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator

n: نحن قدرنا بينكم الموت وما نحن بمسبوقين
t: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

n: علي ان نبدل امثلكم وننشيكم في ما لا تعلمون
t: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know

n: ولقد علمتم النشاه الاولي فلولا تذكرون
t: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember

n: افرءيتم ما تحرثون
t: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow

n: ءانتم تزرعونه ام نحن الزرعون
t: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower

n: لو نشاء لجعلنه حطما فظلتم تفكهون
t: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder

n: انا لمغرمون
t: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt

n: بل نحن محرومون
t: Rather, we have been deprived

n: افرءيتم الماء الذي تشربون
t: And have you seen the water that you drink

n: ءانتم انزلتموه من المزن ام نحن المنزلون
t: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down

n: لو نشاء جعلنه اجاجا فلولا تشكرون
t: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful

n: افرءيتم النار التي تورون
t: And have you seen the fire that you ignite

n: ءانتم انشاتم شجرتها ام نحن المنشون
t: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer

n: نحن جعلنها تذكره ومتعا للمقوين
t: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers

n: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم
t: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great

n: فلا اقسم بموقع النجوم
t: Then I swear by the setting of the stars

n: وانه لقسم لو تعلمون عظيم
t: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great

n: انه لقرءان كريم
t: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an

n: في كتب مكنون
t: In a Register well-protected

n: لا يمسه الا المطهرون
t: None touch it except the purified

n: تنزيل من رب العلمين
t: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds

n: افبهذا الحديث انتم مدهنون
t: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent

n: وتجعلون رزقكم انكم تكذبون
t: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]

n: فلولا اذا بلغت الحلقوم
t: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat

n: وانتم حينيذ تنظرون
t: And you are at that time looking on

n: ونحن اقرب اليه منكم ولكن لا تبصرون
t: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see

n: فلولا ان كنتم غير مدينين
t: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed

n: ترجعونها ان كنتم صدقين
t: Bring it back, if you should be truthful

n: فاما ان كان من المقربين
t: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah

n: فروح وريحان وجنت نعيم
t: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure

n: واما ان كان من اصحب اليمين
t: And if he was of the companions of the right

n: فسلم لك من اصحب اليمين
t: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right

n: واما ان كان من المكذبين الضالين
t: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray

n: فنزل من حميم
t: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

n: وتصليه جحيم
t: And burning in Hellfire

n: ان هذا لهو حق اليقين
t: Indeed, this is the true certainty

n: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم
t: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great

n: سبح لله ما في السموت والارض وهو العزيز الحكيم
t: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

n: له ملك السموت والارض يحي ويميت وهو علي كل شيء قدير
t: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent

n: هو الاول والاخر والظهر والباطن وهو بكل شيء عليم
t: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing

n: هو الذي خلق السموت والارض في سته ايام ثم استوي علي العرش يعلم ما يلج في الارض وما يخرج منها وما ينزل من السماء وما يعرج فيها وهو معكم اين ما كنتم والله بما تعملون بصير
t: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing

n: له ملك السموت والارض والي الله ترجع الامور
t: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allah are returned [all] matters

n: يولج اليل في النهار ويولج النهار في اليل وهو عليم بذات الصدور
t: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and he is Knowing of that within the breasts

n: ءامنوا بالله ورسوله وانفقوا مما جعلكم مستخلفين فيه فالذين ءامنوا منكم وانفقوا لهم اجر كبير
t: Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward

n: وما لكم لا تومنون بالله والرسول يدعوكم لتومنوا بربكم وقد اخذ ميثقكم ان كنتم مومنين
t: And why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers

n: هو الذي ينزل علي عبده ءايت بينت ليخرجكم من الظلمت الي النور وان الله بكم لرءوف رحيم
t: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muhammad] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allah is to you Kind and Merciful

n: وما لكم الا تنفقوا في سبيل الله ولله ميرث السموت والارض لا يستوي منكم من انفق من قبل الفتح وقتل اوليك اعظم درجه من الذين انفقوا من بعد وقتلوا وكلا وعد الله الحسني والله بما تعملون خبير
t: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allah while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allah has promised the best [reward]. And Allah, with what you do, is Acquainted

n: من ذا الذي يقرض الله قرضا حسنا فيضعفه له وله اجر كريم
t: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward

n: يوم تري المومنين والمومنت يسعي نورهم بين ايديهم وبايمنهم بشريكم اليوم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ذلك هو الفوز العظيم
t: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment

n: يوم يقول المنفقون والمنفقت للذين ءامنوا انظرونا نقتبس من نوركم قيل ارجعوا وراءكم فالتمسوا نورا فضرب بينهم بسور له باب باطنه فيه الرحمه وظهره من قبله العذاب
t: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment

n: ينادونهم الم نكن معكم قالوا بلي ولكنكم فتنتم انفسكم وتربصتم وارتبتم وغرتكم الاماني حتي جاء امر الله وغركم بالله الغرور
t: The hypocrites will call to the believers, "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allah. And the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah

n: فاليوم لا يوخذ منكم فديه ولا من الذين كفروا ماويكم النار هي موليكم وبيس المصير
t: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination

n: الم يان للذين ءامنوا ان تخشع قلوبهم لذكر الله وما نزل من الحق ولا يكونوا كالذين اوتوا الكتب من قبل فطال عليهم الامد فقست قلوبهم وكثير منهم فسقون
t: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient

n: اعلموا ان الله يحي الارض بعد موتها قد بينا لكم الايت لعلكم تعقلون
t: Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand

n: ان المصدقين والمصدقت واقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا يضعف لهم ولهم اجر كريم
t: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward

n: والذين ءامنوا بالله ورسله اوليك هم الصديقون والشهداء عند ربهم لهم اجرهم ونورهم والذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا اوليك اصحب الجحيم
t: And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire

n: اعلموا انما الحيوه الدنيا لعب ولهو وزينه وتفاخر بينكم وتكاثر في الامول والاولد كمثل غيث اعجب الكفار نباته ثم يهيج فتريه مصفرا ثم يكون حطما وفي الاخره عذاب شديد ومغفره من الله ورضون وما الحيوه الدنيا الا متع الغرور
t: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion

n: سابقوا الي مغفره من ربكم وجنه عرضها كعرض السماء والارض اعدت للذين ءامنوا بالله ورسله ذلك فضل الله يوتيه من يشاء والله ذو الفضل العظيم
t: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty

n: ما اصاب من مصيبه في الارض ولا في انفسكم الا في كتب من قبل ان نبراها ان ذلك علي الله يسير
t: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allah, is easy

n: لكيلا تاسوا علي ما فاتكم ولا تفرحوا بما ءاتيكم والله لا يحب كل مختال فخور
t: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful

n: الذين يبخلون ويامرون الناس بالبخل ومن يتول فان الله هو الغني الحميد
t: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy

n: لقد ارسلنا رسلنا بالبينت وانزلنا معهم الكتب والميزان ليقوم الناس بالقسط وانزلنا الحديد فيه باس شديد ومنفع للناس وليعلم الله من ينصره ورسله بالغيب ان الله قوي عزيز
t: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allah may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might

n: ولقد ارسلنا نوحا وابرهيم وجعلنا في ذريتهما النبوه والكتب فمنهم مهتد وكثير منهم فسقون
t: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient

n: ثم قفينا علي ءاثرهم برسلنا وقفينا بعيسي ابن مريم وءاتينه الانجيل وجعلنا في قلوب الذين اتبعوه رافه ورحمه ورهبانيه ابتدعوها ما كتبنها عليهم الا ابتغاء رضون الله فما رعوها حق رعايتها فاتينا الذين ءامنوا منهم اجرهم وكثير منهم فسقون
t: Then We sent following their footsteps Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allah. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا اتقوا الله وءامنوا برسوله يوتكم كفلين من رحمته ويجعل لكم نورا تمشون به ويغفر لكم والله غفور رحيم
t: O you who have believed, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

n: ليلا يعلم اهل الكتب الا يقدرون علي شيء من فضل الله وان الفضل بيد الله يوتيه من يشاء والله ذو الفضل العظيم
t: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allah and that [all] bounty is in the hand of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty

n: قد سمع الله قول التي تجدلك في زوجها وتشتكي الي الله والله يسمع تحاوركما ان الله سميع بصير
t: Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues with you, [O Muhammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allah. And Allah hears your dialogue; indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing

n: الذين يظهرون منكم من نسايهم ما هن امهتهم ان امهتهم الا الي ولدنهم وانهم ليقولون منكرا من القول وزورا وان الله لعفو غفور
t: Those who pronounce thihar among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving

n: والذين يظهرون من نسايهم ثم يعودون لما قالوا فتحرير رقبه من قبل ان يتماسا ذلكم توعظون به والله بما تعملون خبير
t: And those who pronounce thihar from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allah is Acquainted with what you do

n: فمن لم يجد فصيام شهرين متتابعين من قبل ان يتماسا فمن لم يستطع فاطعام ستين مسكينا ذلك لتومنوا بالله ورسوله وتلك حدود الله وللكفرين عذاب اليم
t: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allah and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allah. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment

n: ان الذين يحادون الله ورسوله كبتوا كما كبت الذين من قبلهم وقد انزلنا ءايت بينت وللكفرين عذاب مهين
t: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment

n: يوم يبعثهم الله جميعا فينبيهم بما عملوا احصيه الله ونسوه والله علي كل شيء شهيد
t: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allah had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allah is, over all things, Witness

n: الم تر ان الله يعلم ما في السموت وما في الارض ما يكون من نجوي ثلثه الا هو رابعهم ولا خمسه الا هو سادسهم ولا ادني من ذلك ولا اكثر الا هو معهم اين ما كانوا ثم ينبيهم بما عملوا يوم القيمه ان الله بكل شيء عليم
t: Have you not considered that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing

n: الم تر الي الذين نهوا عن النجوي ثم يعودون لما نهوا عنه ويتنجون بالاثم والعدون ومعصيت الرسول واذا جاءوك حيوك بما لم يحيك به الله ويقولون في انفسهم لولا يعذبنا الله بما نقول حسبهم جهنم يصلونها فبيس المصير
t: Have you not considered those who were forbidden from private conversation, then they return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allah does not greet you and say among themselves, "Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?" Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذا تنجيتم فلا تتنجوا بالاثم والعدون ومعصيت الرسول وتنجوا بالبر والتقوي واتقوا الله الذي اليه تحشرون
t: O you who have believed, when you converse privately, do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered

n: انما النجوي من الشيطن ليحزن الذين ءامنوا وليس بضارهم شيا الا باذن الله وعلي الله فليتوكل المومنون
t: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذا قيل لكم تفسحوا في المجلس فافسحوا يفسح الله لكم واذا قيل انشزوا فانشزوا يرفع الله الذين ءامنوا منكم والذين اوتوا العلم درجت والله بما تعملون خبير
t: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allah will make space for you. And when you are told, "Arise," then arise; Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذا نجيتم الرسول فقدموا بين يدي نجويكم صدقه ذلك خير لكم واطهر فان لم تجدوا فان الله غفور رحيم
t: O you who have believed, when you [wish to] privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer. But if you find not [the means] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

n: ءاشفقتم ان تقدموا بين يدي نجويكم صدقت فاذ لم تفعلوا وتاب الله عليكم فاقيموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه واطيعوا الله ورسوله والله خبير بما تعملون
t: Have you feared to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not and Allah has forgiven you, then [at least] establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do

n: الم تر الي الذين تولوا قوما غضب الله عليهم ما هم منكم ولا منهم ويحلفون علي الكذب وهم يعلمون
t: Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying]

n: اعد الله لهم عذابا شديدا انهم ساء ما كانوا يعملون
t: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing

n: اتخذوا ايمنهم جنه فصدوا عن سبيل الله فلهم عذاب مهين
t: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah, and for them is a humiliating punishment

n: لن تغني عنهم امولهم ولا اولدهم من الله شيا اوليك اصحب النار هم فيها خلدون
t: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

n: يوم يبعثهم الله جميعا فيحلفون له كما يحلفون لكم ويحسبون انهم علي شيء الا انهم هم الكذبون
t: On the Day Allah will resurrect them all, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are [standing] on something. Unquestionably, it is they who are the liars

n: استحوذ عليهم الشيطن فانسيهم ذكر الله اوليك حزب الشيطن الا ان حزب الشيطن هم الخسرون
t: Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allah. Those are the party of Satan. Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they will be the losers

n: ان الذين يحادون الله ورسوله اوليك في الاذلين
t: Indeed, the ones who oppose Allah and His Messenger - those will be among the most humbled

n: كتب الله لاغلبن انا ورسلي ان الله قوي عزيز
t: Allah has written, "I will surely overcome, I and My messengers." Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might

n: لا تجد قوما يومنون بالله واليوم الاخر يوادون من حاد الله ورسوله ولو كانوا ءاباءهم او ابناءهم او اخونهم او عشيرتهم اوليك كتب في قلوبهم الايمن وايدهم بروح منه ويدخلهم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه اوليك حزب الله الا ان حزب الله هم المفلحون
t: You will not find a people who believe in Allah and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. Those - He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with spirit from Him. And We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him - those are the party of Allah. Unquestionably, the party of Allah - they are the successful

n: سبح لله ما في السموت وما في الارض وهو العزيز الحكيم
t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

n: هو الذي اخرج الذين كفروا من اهل الكتب من ديرهم لاول الحشر ما ظننتم ان يخرجوا وظنوا انهم مانعتهم حصونهم من الله فاتيهم الله من حيث لم يحتسبوا وقذف في قلوبهم الرعب يخربون بيوتهم بايديهم وايدي المومنين فاعتبروا ياولي الابصر
t: It is He who expelled the ones who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture from their homes at the first gathering. You did not think they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allah; but [the decree of] Allah came upon them from where they had not expected, and He cast terror into their hearts [so] they destroyed their houses by their [own] hands and the hands of the believers. So take warning, O people of vision

n: ولولا ان كتب الله عليهم الجلاء لعذبهم في الدنيا ولهم في الاخره عذاب النار
t: And if not that Allah had decreed for them evacuation, He would have punished them in [this] world, and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire

n: ذلك بانهم شاقوا الله ورسوله ومن يشاق الله فان الله شديد العقاب
t: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah - then indeed, Allah is severe in penalty

n: ما قطعتم من لينه او تركتموها قايمه علي اصولها فباذن الله وليخزي الفسقين
t: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allah and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient

n: وما افاء الله علي رسوله منهم فما اوجفتم عليه من خيل ولا ركاب ولكن الله يسلط رسله علي من يشاء والله علي كل شيء قدير
t: And what Allah restored [of property] to His Messenger from them - you did not spur for it [in an expedition] any horses or camels, but Allah gives His messengers power over whom He wills, and Allah is over all things competent

n: ما افاء الله علي رسوله من اهل القري فلله وللرسول ولذي القربي واليتمي والمسكين وابن السبيل كي لا يكون دوله بين الاغنياء منكم وما ءاتيكم الرسول فخذوه وما نهيكم عنه فانتهوا واتقوا الله ان الله شديد العقاب
t: And what Allah restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns - it is for Allah and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and orphans and the [stranded] traveler - so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you. And whatever the Messenger has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is severe in penalty

n: للفقراء المهجرين الذين اخرجوا من ديرهم وامولهم يبتغون فضلا من الله ورضونا وينصرون الله ورسوله اوليك هم الصدقون
t: For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, seeking bounty from Allah and [His] approval and supporting Allah and His Messenger, [there is also a share]. Those are the truthful

n: والذين تبوءو الدار والايمن من قبلهم يحبون من هاجر اليهم ولا يجدون في صدورهم حاجه مما اوتوا ويوثرون علي انفسهم ولو كان بهم خصاصه ومن يوق شح نفسه فاوليك هم المفلحون
t: And [also for] those who were settled in al-Madinah and [adopted] the faith before them. They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what the emigrants were given but give [them] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful

n: والذين جاءو من بعدهم يقولون ربنا اغفر لنا ولاخوننا الذين سبقونا بالايمن ولا تجعل في قلوبنا غلا للذين ءامنوا ربنا انك رءوف رحيم
t: And [there is a share for] those who came after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful

n: الم تر الي الذين نافقوا يقولون لاخونهم الذين كفروا من اهل الكتب لين اخرجتم لنخرجن معكم ولا نطيع فيكم احدا ابدا وان قوتلتم لننصرنكم والله يشهد انهم لكذبون
t: Have you not considered those who practice hypocrisy, saying to their brothers who have disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, "If you are expelled, we will surely leave with you, and we will not obey, in regard to you, anyone - ever; and if you are fought, we will surely aid you." But Allah testifies that they are liars

n: لين اخرجوا لا يخرجون معهم ولين قوتلوا لا ينصرونهم ولين نصروهم ليولن الادبر ثم لا ينصرون
t: If they are expelled, they will not leave with them, and if they are fought, they will not aid them. And [even] if they should aid them, they will surely turn their backs; then [thereafter] they will not be aided

n: لانتم اشد رهبه في صدورهم من الله ذلك بانهم قوم لا يفقهون
t: You [believers] are more fearful within their breasts than Allah. That is because they are a people who do not understand

n: لا يقتلونكم جميعا الا في قري محصنه او من وراء جدر باسهم بينهم شديد تحسبهم جميعا وقلوبهم شتي ذلك بانهم قوم لا يعقلون
t: They will not fight you all except within fortified cities or from behind walls. Their violence among themselves is severe. You think they are together, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not reason

n: كمثل الذين من قبلهم قريبا ذاقوا وبال امرهم ولهم عذاب اليم
t: [Theirs is] like the example of those shortly before them: they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment

n: كمثل الشيطن اذ قال للانسن اكفر فلما كفر قال اني بريء منك اني اخاف الله رب العلمين
t: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds

n: فكان عقبتهما انهما في النار خلدين فيها وذلك جزوا الظلمين
t: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrong-doers

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا اتقوا الله ولتنظر نفس ما قدمت لغد واتقوا الله ان الله خبير بما تعملون
t: O you who have believed, fear Allah. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what you do

n: ولا تكونوا كالذين نسوا الله فانسيهم انفسهم اوليك هم الفسقون
t: And be not like those who forgot Allah, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient

n: لا يستوي اصحب النار واصحب الجنه اصحب الجنه هم الفايزون
t: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers [of success]

n: لو انزلنا هذا القرءان علي جبل لرايته خشعا متصدعا من خشيه الله وتلك الامثل نضربها للناس لعلهم يتفكرون
t: If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and coming apart from fear of Allah. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought

n: هو الله الذي لا اله الا هو علم الغيب والشهده هو الرحمن الرحيم
t: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

n: هو الله الذي لا اله الا هو الملك القدوس السلم المومن المهيمن العزيز الجبار المتكبر سبحن الله عما يشركون
t: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him

n: هو الله الخلق الباري المصور له الاسماء الحسني يسبح له ما في السموت والارض وهو العزيز الحكيم
t: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تتخذوا عدوي وعدوكم اولياء تلقون اليهم بالموده وقد كفروا بما جاءكم من الحق يخرجون الرسول واياكم ان تومنوا بالله ربكم ان كنتم خرجتم جهدا في سبيلي وابتغاء مرضاتي تسرون اليهم بالموده وانا اعلم بما اخفيتم وما اعلنتم ومن يفعله منكم فقد ضل سواء السبيل
t: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allah, your Lord. If you have come out for jihad in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection, but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way

n: ان يثقفوكم يكونوا لكم اعداء ويبسطوا اليكم ايديهم والسنتهم بالسوء وودوا لو تكفرون
t: If they gain dominance over you, they would be to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve

n: لن تنفعكم ارحامكم ولا اولدكم يوم القيمه يفصل بينكم والله بما تعملون بصير
t: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing

n: قد كانت لكم اسوه حسنه في ابرهيم والذين معه اذ قالوا لقومهم انا برءوا منكم ومما تعبدون من دون الله كفرنا بكم وبدا بيننا وبينكم العدوه والبغضاء ابدا حتي تومنوا بالله وحده الا قول ابرهيم لابيه لاستغفرن لك وما املك لك من الله من شيء ربنا عليك توكلنا واليك انبنا واليك المصير
t: There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allah. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allah alone" except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allah. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination

n: ربنا لا تجعلنا فتنه للذين كفروا واغفر لنا ربنا انك انت العزيز الحكيم
t: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

n: لقد كان لكم فيهم اسوه حسنه لمن كان يرجوا الله واليوم الاخر ومن يتول فان الله هو الغني الحميد
t: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy

n: عسي الله ان يجعل بينكم وبين الذين عاديتم منهم موده والله قدير والله غفور رحيم
t: Perhaps Allah will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allah is competent, and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

n: لا ينهيكم الله عن الذين لم يقتلوكم في الدين ولم يخرجوكم من ديركم ان تبروهم وتقسطوا اليهم ان الله يحب المقسطين
t: Allah does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly

n: انما ينهيكم الله عن الذين قتلوكم في الدين واخرجوكم من ديركم وظهروا علي اخراجكم ان تولوهم ومن يتولهم فاوليك هم الظلمون
t: Allah only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - [forbids] that you make allies of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذا جاءكم المومنت مهجرت فامتحنوهن الله اعلم بايمنهن فان علمتموهن مومنت فلا ترجعوهن الي الكفار لا هن حل لهم ولا هم يحلون لهن وءاتوهم ما انفقوا ولا جناح عليكم ان تنكحوهن اذا ءاتيتموهن اجورهن ولا تمسكوا بعصم الكوافر وسلوا ما انفقتم وليسلوا ما انفقوا ذلكم حكم الله يحكم بينكم والله عليم حكيم
t: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine them. Allah is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful [wives] for them, nor are they lawful [husbands] for them. But give the disbelievers what they have spent. And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation. And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them ask for what they have spent. That is the judgement of Allah; He judges between you. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

n: وان فاتكم شيء من ازوجكم الي الكفار فعاقبتم فاتوا الذين ذهبت ازوجهم مثل ما انفقوا واتقوا الله الذي انتم به مومنون
t: And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain [something], then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear Allah, in whom you are believers

n: يايها النبي اذا جاءك المومنت يبايعنك علي ان لا يشركن بالله شيا ولا يسرقن ولا يزنين ولا يقتلن اولدهن ولا ياتين ببهتن يفترينه بين ايديهن وارجلهن ولا يعصينك في معروف فبايعهن واستغفر لهن الله ان الله غفور رحيم
t: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allah, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs, nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تتولوا قوما غضب الله عليهم قد ييسوا من الاخره كما ييس الكفار من اصحب القبور
t: O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry. They have despaired of [reward in] the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of [meeting] the inhabitants of the graves

n: سبح لله ما في السموت وما في الارض وهو العزيز الحكيم
t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا لم تقولون ما لا تفعلون
t: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do

n: كبر مقتا عند الله ان تقولوا ما لا تفعلون
t: Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do

n: ان الله يحب الذين يقتلون في سبيله صفا كانهم بنين مرصوص
t: Indeed, Allah loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly

n: واذ قال موسي لقومه يقوم لم توذونني وقد تعلمون اني رسول الله اليكم فلما زاغوا ازاغ الله قلوبهم والله لا يهدي القوم الفسقين
t: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allah to you?" And when they deviated, Allah caused their hearts to deviate. And Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people

n: واذ قال عيسي ابن مريم يبني اسرءيل اني رسول الله اليكم مصدقا لما بين يدي من التوريه ومبشرا برسول ياتي من بعدي اسمه احمد فلما جاءهم بالبينت قالوا هذا سحر مبين
t: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allah to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Ahmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic

n: ومن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله الكذب وهو يدعي الي الاسلم والله لا يهدي القوم الظلمين
t: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah untruth while he is being invited to Islam. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

n: يريدون ليطفوا نور الله بافوههم والله متم نوره ولو كره الكفرون
t: They want to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah will perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it

n: هو الذي ارسل رسوله بالهدي ودين الحق ليظهره علي الدين كله ولو كره المشركون
t: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allah dislike it

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا هل ادلكم علي تجره تنجيكم من عذاب اليم
t: O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment

n: تومنون بالله ورسوله وتجهدون في سبيل الله بامولكم وانفسكم ذلكم خير لكم ان كنتم تعلمون
t: [It is that] you believe in Allah and His Messenger and strive in the cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if you should know

n: يغفر لكم ذنوبكم ويدخلكم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر ومسكن طيبه في جنت عدن ذلك الفوز العظيم
t: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment

n: واخري تحبونها نصر من الله وفتح قريب وبشر المومنين
t: And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allah and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا كونوا انصار الله كما قال عيسي ابن مريم للحوارين من انصاري الي الله قال الحواريون نحن انصار الله فامنت طايفه من بني اسرءيل وكفرت طايفه فايدنا الذين ءامنوا علي عدوهم فاصبحوا ظهرين
t: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allah, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allah?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allah." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant

n: يسبح لله ما في السموت وما في الارض الملك القدوس العزيز الحكيم
t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

n: هو الذي بعث في الامين رسولا منهم يتلوا عليهم ءايته ويزكيهم ويعلمهم الكتب والحكمه وان كانوا من قبل لفي ضلل مبين
t: It is He who has sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom - although they were before in clear error

n: وءاخرين منهم لما يلحقوا بهم وهو العزيز الحكيم
t: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

n: ذلك فضل الله يوتيه من يشاء والله ذو الفضل العظيم
t: That is the bounty of Allah, which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty

n: مثل الذين حملوا التوريه ثم لم يحملوها كمثل الحمار يحمل اسفارا بيس مثل القوم الذين كذبوا بايت الله والله لا يهدي القوم الظلمين
t: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allah. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

n: قل يايها الذين هادوا ان زعمتم انكم اولياء لله من دون الناس فتمنوا الموت ان كنتم صدقين
t: Say, "O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allah, excluding the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful

n: ولا يتمنونه ابدا بما قدمت ايديهم والله عليم بالظلمين
t: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers

n: قل ان الموت الذي تفرون منه فانه ملقيكم ثم تردون الي علم الغيب والشهده فينبيكم بما كنتم تعملون
t: Say, "Indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you about what you used to do

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذا نودي للصلوه من يوم الجمعه فاسعوا الي ذكر الله وذروا البيع ذلكم خير لكم ان كنتم تعلمون
t: O you who have believed, when [the adhan] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew

n: فاذا قضيت الصلوه فانتشروا في الارض وابتغوا من فضل الله واذكروا الله كثيرا لعلكم تفلحون
t: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often that you may succeed

n: واذا راوا تجره او لهوا انفضوا اليها وتركوك قايما قل ما عند الله خير من اللهو ومن التجره والله خير الرزقين
t: But when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muhammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, "What is with Allah is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allah is the best of providers

n: اذا جاءك المنفقون قالوا نشهد انك لرسول الله والله يعلم انك لرسوله والله يشهد ان المنفقين لكذبون
t: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muhammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allah." And Allah knows that you are His Messenger, and Allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars

n: اتخذوا ايمنهم جنه فصدوا عن سبيل الله انهم ساء ما كانوا يعملون
t: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing

n: ذلك بانهم ءامنوا ثم كفروا فطبع علي قلوبهم فهم لا يفقهون
t: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand

n: واذا رايتهم تعجبك اجسامهم وان يقولوا تسمع لقولهم كانهم خشب مسنده يحسبون كل صيحه عليهم هم العدو فاحذرهم قتلهم الله اني يوفكون
t: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah destroy them; how are they deluded

n: واذا قيل لهم تعالوا يستغفر لكم رسول الله لووا رءوسهم ورايتهم يصدون وهم مستكبرون
t: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant

n: سواء عليهم استغفرت لهم ام لم تستغفر لهم لن يغفر الله لهم ان الله لا يهدي القوم الفسقين
t: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allah forgive them. Indeed, Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people

n: هم الذين يقولون لا تنفقوا علي من عند رسول الله حتي ينفضوا ولله خزاين السموت والارض ولكن المنفقين لا يفقهون
t: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allah until they disband." And to Allah belongs the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand

n: يقولون لين رجعنا الي المدينه ليخرجن الاعز منها الاذل ولله العزه ولرسوله وللمومنين ولكن المنفقين لا يعلمون
t: They say, "If we return to al-Madinah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allah belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know

n: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تلهكم امولكم ولا اولدكم عن ذكر الله ومن يفعل ذلك فاوليك هم الخسرون
t: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that - then those are the losers

n: وانفقوا من ما رزقنكم من قبل ان ياتي احدكم الموت فيقول رب لولا اخرتني الي اجل قريب فاصدق واكن من الصلحين
t: And spend [in the way of Allah] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous

n: ولن يوخر الله نفسا اذا جاء اجلها والله خبير بما تعملون
t: But never will Allah delay a soul when its time has come. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do

n: يسبح لله ما في السموت وما في الارض له الملك وله الحمد وهو علي كل شيء قدير
t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent

n: هو الذي خلقكم فمنكم كافر ومنكم مومن والله بما تعملون بصير
t: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing

n: خلق السموت والارض بالحق وصوركم فاحسن صوركم واليه المصير
t: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination

n: يعلم ما في السموت والارض ويعلم ما تسرون وما تعلنون والله عليم بذات الصدور
t: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts

n: الم ياتكم نبوا الذين كفروا من قبل فذاقوا وبال امرهم ولهم عذاب اليم
